subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `outputSchema` become the supported plugin API for describing and validating `AgentToolResult.details` across Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and well-proven, but accepting a new plugin SDK field and its pre-execution/post-hook failure semantics establishes a durable external contract that automation cannot choose.

options.title: Approve the optional contract
options.body: Land the shared optional field after the documented corrections, conflict refresh, and compatibility coverage, preserving existing behavior for tools that omit it.

options.title: Keep it internal first
options.body: Restrict result schemas to core-owned tools until the external plugin validation and evolution policy is settled.

options.title: Pause structured outputs
options.body: Retain unknown result hints and raw-first processing rather than adding a new plugin API at this time.

recommendation.title: Approve the optional contract
recommendation.body: Land the shared optional field after the documented corrections, conflict refresh, and compatibility coverage, preserving existing behavior for tools that omit it.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged Code Mode implementation history and assignment make this the strongest available routing candidate for the API-direction decision.
